```ts
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import { createHash } from "node:crypto";
import { definePlugin, runPlugin } from "@kobrixa/plugin-sdk";
const value = <T>(result: { ok: true; value: T } | { ok: false; error: unknown }): T => {
  assert.equal(result.ok, true);
  if (!result.ok) throw new Error("fixture business failure");
  return result.value;
};
void runPlugin(definePlugin({
  activate(ctx) {
    ctx.commands.register("test.persistence.run", async () => {
      const initial = value(await ctx.settings.read({ schemaVersion: 1 }));
      const watch = value(await ctx.settings.watch({ schemaVersion: 1 }));
      const updated = value(await ctx.settings.update({ schemaVersion: 1,
        expectedRevision: initial.revision, changes: [{ key: "fixture.enabled", value: true }] }));
      const conflict = await ctx.settings.update({ schemaVersion: 1,
        expectedRevision: initial.revision, changes: [{ key: "fixture.enabled", value: false }] });
      assert.equal(conflict.ok, false);
      if (!conflict.ok) assert.equal(conflict.error.code, "PLUGIN_E_SETTINGS_CONFLICT");
      assert.notEqual(updated.snapshot.revision, initial.revision);
      const bytes = Buffer.alloc(262144, 0x61);
      const digest = createHash("sha256").update(bytes).digest("hex");
      const write = value(await ctx.storage.beginWrite({ target: { mode: "create" },
        kind: "test.fixture", schemaVersion: 1, label: "Synthetic record",
        mediaType: "application/octet-stream", byteLength: bytes.length, sha256: digest }));
      value(await ctx.storage.writeChunk({ write: write.write, offset: 0, data: bytes.toString("base64") }));
      value(await ctx.storage.sealWrite({ write: write.write }));
      const committed = value(await ctx.storage.commitWrite({ write: write.write }));
      const duplicate = value(await ctx.storage.commitWrite({ write: write.write }));
      assert.deepEqual(duplicate.receipt, committed.receipt);
      const list = value(await ctx.storage.list({ kind: "test.fixture", limit: 1 }));
      assert.equal(list.entries.length, 1);
      const read = value(await ctx.storage.openRead({ id: committed.record.id,
        expectedRevision: committed.record.revision, schemaVersion: 1 }));
      const chunk = value(await ctx.storage.readChunk({ read: read.read, offset: 0, maxBytes: 262144 }));
      assert.equal(createHash("sha256").update(Buffer.from(chunk.data, "base64")).digest("hex"), digest);
      assert.equal(chunk.eof, true);
      value(await ctx.storage.closeRead({ read: read.read }));
      value(await ctx.storage.flush({}));
      assert.equal(value(await ctx.settings.unwatch({ subscriptionId: watch.subscriptionId })).removed, true);
      assert.equal(value(await ctx.settings.unwatch({ subscriptionId: watch.subscriptionId })).removed, false);
    });
  },
  async drain({ request, storage }) {
    assert.equal(request.checkpoints.length, 0);
    value(await storage.flush({}));
    return { ok: true, value: { status: "submitted", writes: [] } };
  },
})).catch(() => { process.exitCode = 1; });
```

- [ ] **Step 4: Implement real child termination and bounded process transport support**

Implement `terminateAtBoundary` below in `plugin-persistence-main.ts` for actual child process exit evidence. A kill is permitted only after the real worker control acknowledges its exact paused fault point. Use `PersistenceFaultControl.terminate()` for the worker; the helper below supervises whole-app kill trials and records actual OS exit. Do not infer a worker PID from the main process.

```js
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import { spawn } from "node:child_process";
import { once } from "node:events";
export async function terminateAtBoundary(child, evidence) {
  assert.ok(Number.isSafeInteger(child.pid) && child.pid > 0);
  assert.equal(evidence.pid, child.pid);
  assert.equal(evidence.paused, true);
  assert.equal(typeof evidence.point, "string");
  assert.equal(child.exitCode, null);
  const exited = once(child, "exit");
  let platformTermination;
  if (process.platform === "win32") {
    const killer = spawn("taskkill", ["/PID", String(child.pid), "/T", "/F"], { stdio: "ignore" });
    const [code] = await once(killer, "exit");
    assert.equal(code, 0);
    platformTermination = "taskkill-/T-/F";
  } else {
    assert.equal(child.kill("SIGKILL"), true);
  }
  let timer;
  try {
    const [exitCode, signal] = await Promise.race([exited, new Promise((_, reject) => {
      timer = setTimeout(() => reject(new Error("killed child did not exit within 5 seconds")), 5000);
    })]);
    assert.notEqual(exitCode, 0);
    return { pid: child.pid, point: evidence.point, pauseAcknowledged: true,
      exitCode, signal, ...(platformTermination ? { platformTermination } : {}) };
  } finally { clearTimeout(timer); }
}
```

In the same `plugin-persistence-main.ts`, implement the following actual transport primitives. The producer attaches the official runtime router and immutable AM-01 channel owner before initialize, and waits through initialized → initial-binding → ready. Transport errors are fatal evidence, not a reason to retry a mutation.

```ts
import { utilityProcess, MessageChannelMain } from "electron";
import { spawn, type ChildProcessWithoutNullStreams } from "node:child_process";
import { ContentLengthDecoder, encodeContentLength, RpcPeer, RpcError, RPC_ERRORS,
  type MessageChannelLike } from "@kobrixa/plugin-protocol";

export function launchJs(entry: string, cwd: string) {
  const child = utilityProcess.fork(entry, [], { cwd, stdio: "pipe", serviceName: "Persistence acceptance" });
  const { port1, port2 } = new MessageChannelMain();
  const channel: MessageChannelLike = {
    send: (text) => port1.postMessage(text),
    onMessage(listener) {
      const onMessage = (event: Electron.MessageEvent) => listener(typeof event.data === "string" ? event.data : "");
      port1.on("message", onMessage);
      return () => port1.off("message", onMessage);
    },
  };
  port1.start();
  const peer = new RpcPeer(channel);
  const ready = new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
    let expired = false;
    const timeout = setTimeout(() => {
      expired = true; child.kill(); port1.close(); port2.close();
      reject(new Error("JS consumer spawn timeout"));
    }, 10000);
    child.once("spawn", () => {
      if (expired) { child.kill(); return; }
      clearTimeout(timeout);
      child.postMessage("kobrixa-plugin-port", [port2]);
      resolve();
    });
    child.once("exit", (code) => {
      expired = true; clearTimeout(timeout);
      reject(new Error(`JS consumer exited ${code}`));
    });
  });
  const dispose = () => { peer.close(); port1.close(); child.kill(); };
  return { child, peer, ready, dispose };
}
export function launchPython(interpreter: string, entry: string, sdkRoot: string) {
  const child: ChildProcessWithoutNullStreams = spawn(interpreter, [entry], {
    stdio: "pipe", env: { ...process.env, PYTHONPATH: sdkRoot, PYTHONUNBUFFERED: "1" },
  });
  const decoder = new ContentLengthDecoder();
  const listeners = new Set<(text: string) => void>();
  const channel: MessageChannelLike = {
    send(text) { child.stdin.write(encodeContentLength(text)); },
    onMessage(listener) { listeners.add(listener); return () => listeners.delete(listener); },
  };
  const peer = new RpcPeer(channel);
  child.stdout.on("data", (chunk: Buffer) => {
    try { for (const text of decoder.push(chunk)) for (const listener of listeners) listener(text); }
    catch { peer.close(new RpcError(RPC_ERRORS.connectionClosed, "Invalid Python frame")); child.kill(); }
  });
  // Drain stderr without accumulating unbounded diagnostic output.
  child.stderr.on("data", () => {});
  child.once("exit", () => peer.close());
  const ready = new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
    child.once("spawn", resolve); child.once("error", reject);
  });
  return { child, peer, ready, dispose() { peer.close(); child.kill(); } };
}
```

Only the real runtime router may handle the public requests. `launchJs` is **controller runs outside sandbox**; Python process tests also require the controller-selected interpreter, and a missing interpreter is pending/failed, never a passed parity test.

```ts
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
const ADDITIONAL_FOUNDATION_CHECKS = {
  "all-optional-off": ["noProcessSettings", "durableRecoveryRestored", "committedExportHash", "sealedExportHash"],
  "sealed-ttl": ["originalExpiryPreserved", "expiredPinRejected", "checkpointOnlyNoInventedBytes"],
  "unknown-publication": ["exportOriginalJobReconciled", "noRepublish", "destinationIdentityPreserved"],
  "action-replay": ["freshCoreAction", "cancelNoWrite", "lateDialogReleased", "identitySwapRejected"],
  "storage-ui-pressure": ["namespaceIncludesSettingsImport", "targetExcludesSettings", "afterBarrierExcluded"],
  "import-restart": ["atomicImportReceipt", "barrierRestored", "originalBytesUnchanged"],
} satisfies Partial<Record<FoundationCase, readonly string[]>>;
export function assertFoundationEvidence(id: FoundationCase, evidence: CaseEvidence): void {
  const required = FOUNDATION_CHECKS[id];
  assert.ok(required, `Unknown foundation case ${id}`);
  for (const key of required.checks) {
    assert.ok(Object.hasOwn(evidence.checks, key), `${id}: missing check ${key}`);
    const value = evidence.checks[key];
    assert.ok(typeof value === "string" || typeof value === "boolean" ||
      typeof value === "number" && Number.isFinite(value) ||
      Array.isArray(value) && value.every(item => typeof item === "string" ||
        typeof item === "number" && Number.isFinite(item)), `${id}: invalid check ${key}`);
  }
  for (const key of Object.keys(evidence.checks))
    assert.ok(required.checks.includes(key), `${id}: undeclared check ${key}`);
  for (const kind of required.events)
    assert.ok(evidence.events.some(event => event.kind === kind), `${id}: missing event ${kind}`);
  for (const event of evidence.events) {
    assert.ok(Number.isSafeInteger(event.turn) && event.turn >= 0, `${id}: invalid event turn`);
    assert.ok(Number.isFinite(event.time) && event.time >= 0, `${id}: invalid event time`);
    if (event.deadline !== undefined)
      assert.ok(Number.isFinite(event.deadline) && event.deadline >= 0, `${id}: invalid deadline`);
  }
  for (const key of required.samples) {
    assert.ok(Object.hasOwn(evidence.samples, key), `${id}: missing sample ${key}`);
    const values = evidence.samples[key]!;
    assert.ok(values.length >= 30 && values.every(value => Number.isFinite(value) && value >= 0),
      `${id}: ${key} needs 30 finite nonnegative measurements`);
  }
  for (const key of Object.keys(evidence.samples))
    assert.ok(required.samples.includes(key), `${id}: undeclared sample ${key}`);
}
function assertRealComposition(fixture: FoundationFixture): void {
  const c = fixture.composition;
  assert.equal(c.persistenceProfile, c.profile);
  assert.equal(c.journalProfile, c.profile);
  assert.equal(c.workerCount, 1);
  assert.equal(c.reservationListenerCount, 1);
  assert.equal(typeof c.host.settings.open, "function");
  assert.equal(typeof c.host.recovery.export, "function");
  c.profile.assertHeld();
  const off = c.host.recovery.subscribe(() => {});
  try { assert.deepEqual(c.host.recovery.snapshot(), c.host.participant.recoverySnapshot()); }
  finally { off(); }
}
// runFoundationEvidence belongs to the outside controller, not this Electron producer.
```

```ts
import { randomBytes, createHash } from "node:crypto";
import type { PluginProcess, ProcessExit } from "@kobrixa/plugin-runtime";
import type { ResourceOwner } from "@kobrixa/plugin-protocol";
import type { Principal, Stage3RuntimePorts, DrainOffer } from "@kobrixa/plugin-runtime";
import type { DeviceBrokerPort } from "../../apps/desktop/src/main/device-broker/broker-port.js";
import type { PersistenceFaultControl } from "../../apps/desktop/src/main/plugins/persistence/worker.js";

import type { PluginController } from "../../apps/desktop/src/main/plugins/controller.js";

type LiveConsumer = {
  principal: () => Principal;
  child: PluginProcess;
};
type LifecycleCaseInput = {
  now: () => number;
  broker: DeviceBrokerPort;
  host: PersistenceHost;
  stage3: Stage3RuntimePorts;
  plugins: Pick<PluginController, "setEnabled">;
  fault: PersistenceFaultControl;
  recording: LiveConsumer;
  settings: LiveConsumer;
};
function accepted<T>(result: {ok:true;value:T}|{ok:false;error:unknown}): T {
  if (!result.ok) throw new Error(`Live operation failed: ${JSON.stringify(result.error)}`);
  return result.value;
}
function pluginPrincipal(consumer: LiveConsumer): Extract<Principal, {kind:"plugin"}> {
  const principal = consumer.principal();
  if (principal.kind !== "plugin") throw new Error("Expected admitted plugin channel");
  return principal;
}
function sameExecution(a: ResourceOwner, b: ResourceOwner): boolean {
  return a.sourceKey === b.sourceKey && a.pluginId === b.pluginId &&
    a.generation === b.generation && a.hostEpoch === b.hostEpoch && a.processEpoch === b.processEpoch;
}
async function within<T>(operation: Promise<T>, label: string): Promise<T> {
  let timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined;
  try {
    return await Promise.race([operation, new Promise<never>((_, reject) => {
      timer = setTimeout(() => reject(new Error(`Missing live observation: ${label}`)), 15000);
    })]);
  } finally { clearTimeout(timer); }
}
function latch<T>() {
  let resolve!: (value: T) => void;
  const promise = new Promise<T>(done => { resolve = done; });
  return {promise, resolve};
}
function eventRecorder(now: () => number) {
  const events: CaseEvidence["events"] = [];
  let turn = 0, scheduled = false;
  return {
    events,
    record(kind: string, fields: Pick<CaseEvidence["events"][number], "grant"|"deadline"> = {}) {
      // One ordinal per observed synchronous segment. The boundary is an actual
      // microtask, never an ordinal assigned from the expected event order.
      events.push({kind, turn, time: now(), ...fields});
      if (!scheduled) {
        scheduled = true;
        queueMicrotask(() => { turn++; scheduled = false; });
      }
    },
  };
}
async function reserveLiveRecording(input: LifecycleCaseInput) {
  const signal = new AbortController().signal;
  const principal = pluginPrincipal(input.recording);
  const inventory = accepted(await input.broker.request(principal, "devices/list", {}, signal));
  const provider = inventory.providers.find(row => row.state === "available");
  if (!provider) throw new Error("No admitted fake provider");
  let session = inventory.sessions.find(row => row.providerId === provider.providerId && row.state === "connected");
  if (!session) {
    const discovered = accepted(await input.broker.request(principal, "devices/discover",
      {providerId: provider.providerId}, signal));
    const candidate = discovered.candidates[0];
    if (!candidate) throw new Error("Fake provider returned no candidate");
    session = accepted(await input.broker.request(principal, "devices/connect",
      {target:{kind:"candidate", candidateId:candidate.candidateId}}, signal)).session;
  }
  const current = accepted(await input.broker.request(principal, "devices/session",
    {sessionId:session.sessionId}, signal));
  const channel = current.sources.channels.find(row => row.state === "ready" && row.kind === "input");
  if (!channel) throw new Error("Fake provider returned no recording input");
  return accepted(await input.broker.request(principal, "devices/recording/reserve", {
    sessionId:session.sessionId, channelIds:[channel.channelId],
    expectedSourceRevision:current.sources.sourceRevision,
  }, signal)).reservation;
}

export async function produceRetirement(input: LifecycleCaseInput): Promise<CaseEvidence> {
  const participant = input.host.participant;
  if (input.stage3.persistence !== participant) throw new Error("Detached persistence participant");
  const principal = pluginPrincipal(input.recording), owner = principal.owner;
  const signal = new AbortController().signal;
  await reserveLiveRecording(input);
  const bytes = randomBytes(4096), sha256 = createHash("sha256").update(bytes).digest("hex");
  const write = accepted(await input.host.request(principal, "storage/beginWrite", {
    target:{mode:"create"}, kind:"test.retirement", schemaVersion:1, label:"Retirement payload",
    mediaType:"application/octet-stream", byteLength:bytes.length, sha256,
  }, signal));
  accepted(await input.host.request(principal, "storage/writeChunk",
    {write:write.write, offset:0, data:bytes.toString("base64")}, signal));
  accepted(await input.host.request(principal, "storage/sealWrite", {write:write.write}, signal));

  const recorder = eventRecorder(input.now), frozen = latch<DrainOffer>(), exited = latch<ProcessExit>();
  const retire = input.stage3.device.retire, freeze = participant.freeze,
    drain = participant.drain, endReservation = participant.endReservation;
  let firstDeadline: number | undefined;
  let commit: Promise<unknown> | undefined, disabling: Promise<unknown> | undefined;
  let armed = false;
  const onExit = (exit: ProcessExit) => { recorder.record("process-exit"); exited.resolve(exit); };
  const unsubscribeExit = input.recording.child.onExit(onExit);
  const remember = (offer: DrainOffer | null) => {
    if (offer && sameExecution(offer.owner, owner) && firstDeadline === undefined)
      firstDeadline = offer.deadlineMonotonicMs;
  };
  participant.endReservation = function(event, deadline) {
    const offer = endReservation.call(this, event, deadline); remember(offer); return offer;
  };
  input.stage3.device.retire = function(retired, reason) {
    const result = retire.call(this, retired, reason);
    if (sameExecution(retired, owner)) recorder.record("retire", {grant:result.drain});
    return result;
  };
  participant.freeze = function(retired, reason, deadline, grant) {
    const offer = freeze.call(this, retired, reason, deadline, grant);
    if (sameExecution(retired, owner)) {
      remember(offer);
      recorder.record("freeze", {grant, deadline:offer.deadlineMonotonicMs});
      frozen.resolve(offer);
    }
    return offer;
  };
  participant.drain = function(offer, dispatch) {
    if (sameExecution(offer.owner, owner))
      recorder.record("drain", {deadline:offer.deadlineMonotonicMs});
    return drain.call(this, offer, dispatch);
  };
  try {
    const traceStart = input.fault.trace().length;
    const reached = input.fault.reached("before-publish");
    input.fault.arm("before-publish", "pause"); armed = true;
    // Install rejection handling immediately; losing the owner can reject this call.
    commit = input.host.request(principal, "storage/commitWrite", {write:write.write}, signal)
      .then(result => ({result}), error => ({error}));
    await within(reached, "retirement publication pause");
    const trace = input.fault.trace().slice(traceStart);
    if (!trace.some(row => row.point === "before-publish" && row.ticket !== null))
      throw new Error("Retirement did not pause a worker publication ticket");
    disabling = input.plugins.setEnabled(owner.sourceKey, false).then(result => {
      if (!result.ok) throw new Error(`Retirement refused: ${JSON.stringify(result)}`);
      return result;
    });
    // Observe synchronously fenced state before permitting the worker continuation.
    await within(Promise.race([frozen.promise, disabling.then(() => {
      throw new Error("Disable completed without freeze");
    })]), "retirement freeze");
    input.fault.release("before-publish"); armed = false;
    await within(Promise.all([commit, disabling, exited.promise]), "original process exit");
    if (firstDeadline === undefined) throw new Error("No original drain deadline observed");
    const evidence: CaseEvidence = {checks:{firstDeadline}, events:recorder.events, samples:{}};
    assertFoundationEvidence("retirement", evidence);
    return evidence;
  } finally {
    if (armed) input.fault.release("before-publish");
    // Await any started work before restoring instrumentation; propagate cleanup failure.
    try { await within(Promise.allSettled([commit, disabling].filter(value => value !== undefined)), "retirement cleanup"); }
    finally {
      participant.endReservation = endReservation; participant.freeze = freeze; participant.drain = drain;
      input.stage3.device.retire = retire;
      unsubscribeExit();
    }
  }
}

export async function produceHealthyRelease(input: LifecycleCaseInput): Promise<CaseEvidence> {
  if (input.stage3.persistence !== input.host.participant)
    throw new Error("Detached persistence participant");
  const owner = pluginPrincipal(input.recording).owner;
  const other = pluginPrincipal(input.settings);
  if (sameExecution(owner, other.owner)) throw new Error("Settings needs an unrelated admitted consumer");
  const reservation = await reserveLiveRecording(input);
  const generationBefore = owner.generation;
  const participant = input.host.participant, retire = input.stage3.device.retire,
    freeze = participant.freeze, drain = participant.drain;
  const retireCalls: ResourceOwner[] = [], freezeCalls: ResourceOwner[] = [], exits: ProcessExit[] = [];
  const drains: Promise<unknown>[] = [];
  const onExit = (exit: ProcessExit) => { exits.push(exit); };
  const unsubscribeRecording = input.recording.child.onExit(onExit);
  const unsubscribeSettings = input.settings.child.onExit(onExit);
  input.stage3.device.retire = function(retired, reason) {
    if (sameExecution(retired, owner) || sameExecution(retired, other.owner)) retireCalls.push(retired);
    return retire.call(this, retired, reason);
  };
  participant.freeze = function(retired, reason, deadline, grant) {
    if (sameExecution(retired, owner) || sameExecution(retired, other.owner)) freezeCalls.push(retired);
    return freeze.call(this, retired, reason, deadline, grant);
  };
  participant.drain = function(offer, dispatch) {
    const result = drain.call(this, offer, dispatch);
    // Attach both handlers immediately without swallowing a failed drain observation.
    if (sameExecution(offer.owner, owner)) drains.push(result.then(value => ({value}), error => ({error})));
    return result;
  };
  try {
    const signal = new AbortController().signal;
    const before = accepted(await input.host.request(other, "settings/read", {schemaVersion:1}, signal));
    const enabled = before.values.find(row => row.key === "fixture.enabled");
    if (!enabled || typeof enabled.value !== "boolean") throw new Error("Missing live fixture setting");
    accepted(await input.broker.request(pluginPrincipal(input.recording), "devices/recording/release",
      {reservationId:reservation.reservationId}, signal));
    // onEnded schedules its real work after the current synchronous turn.
    await new Promise<void>(resolve => setImmediate(resolve));
    const settled = await within(Promise.all(drains), "reservation-end drains");
    for (const result of settled) if (result && typeof result === "object" && "error" in result)
      throw result.error;
    const updated = await input.host.request(other, "settings/update", {schemaVersion:before.schemaVersion,
      expectedRevision:before.revision, changes:[{key:enabled.key, value:!enabled.value}]}, signal);
    const after = accepted(await input.host.request(other, "settings/read", {schemaVersion:1}, signal));
    // Fresh traffic must succeed on the still-admitted original channel; it must
    // not depend on how long the broker retains an ended reservation tombstone.
    accepted(await input.broker.request(pluginPrincipal(input.recording), "devices/list", {}, signal));
    const current = pluginPrincipal(input.recording).owner;
    if (!sameExecution(owner, current) ||
        !sameExecution(other.owner, pluginPrincipal(input.settings).owner))
      throw new Error("Healthy release replaced an original execution");
    const evidence: CaseEvidence = {checks:{
      retireCalls:retireCalls.length, freezeCalls:freezeCalls.length, processExits:exits.length,
      unrelatedSettingsCommitted:updated.ok && after.revision === updated.value.snapshot.revision &&
        after.revision !== before.revision && after.values.some(row => row.key === enabled.key && row.value === !enabled.value),
      generationBefore, generationAfter:current.generation,
    }, events:[], samples:{}};
    assertFoundationEvidence("healthy-release", evidence);
    return evidence;
  } finally {
    input.stage3.device.retire = retire; participant.freeze = freeze; participant.drain = drain;
    unsubscribeRecording();
    unsubscribeSettings();
  }
}
```

Append this source regression to `plugin-persistence-interop.test.mjs` (merge `readFile` and the TypeScript import). It complements report completeness: JSON cannot distinguish a literal `true` from a measured comparison that returned true. Inspect only producer functions, never the vocabulary or verifier fixtures. Resolve constant aliases as well as direct literal initializers. Mutation-test every discovered check with boolean, numeric, string and array literals; the source gate must reject every replacement, including literals that could match the value-only oracle.

```js
import ts from "typescript";
import { readFile } from "node:fs/promises";

function assertNoConstantProducerChecks(source) {
  const file = ts.createSourceFile("plugin-persistence-main.ts", source,
    ts.ScriptTarget.Latest, true, ts.ScriptKind.TS);
  const constants = new Map();
  const visitDeclarations = node => {
    if (ts.isVariableDeclarationList(node) && (node.flags & ts.NodeFlags.Const))
      for (const declaration of node.declarations)
        if (ts.isIdentifier(declaration.name) && declaration.initializer) {
          // Ambiguous names are not resolved across lexical scopes.
          const name = declaration.name.text;
          constants.set(name, constants.has(name) ? null : declaration.initializer);
        }
    ts.forEachChild(node, visitDeclarations);
  };
  visitDeclarations(file);
  function constant(node, seen = new Set()) {
    if (ts.isParenthesizedExpression(node) || ts.isAsExpression(node) ||
        ts.isSatisfiesExpression(node) || ts.isNonNullExpression(node))
      return constant(node.expression, seen);
    if (ts.isLiteralExpression(node) || [ts.SyntaxKind.TrueKeyword,
      ts.SyntaxKind.FalseKeyword, ts.SyntaxKind.NullKeyword].includes(node.kind)) return true;
    if (ts.isIdentifier(node)) {
      if (seen.has(node.text)) return false;
      const initializer = constants.get(node.text);
      return initializer ? constant(initializer, new Set([...seen, node.text])) : false;
    }
    if (ts.isPrefixUnaryExpression(node)) return constant(node.operand, seen);
    if (ts.isBinaryExpression(node)) return constant(node.left, seen) && constant(node.right, seen);
    if (ts.isConditionalExpression(node)) return constant(node.condition, seen) &&
      constant(node.whenTrue, seen) && constant(node.whenFalse, seen);
    if (ts.isArrayLiteralExpression(node)) return node.elements.every(value => constant(value, seen));
    return false;
  }
  const checks = [];
  const name = node => ts.isIdentifier(node) || ts.isStringLiteral(node) ? node.text : undefined;
  const visit = node => {
    if (ts.isPropertyAssignment(node) && name(node.name) === "checks" &&
        ts.isObjectLiteralExpression(node.initializer)) {
      for (const property of node.initializer.properties) {
        assert.ok(ts.isPropertyAssignment(property) || ts.isShorthandPropertyAssignment(property),
          "Producer checks must have explicit keys; no spread/default evidence");
        const expression = ts.isPropertyAssignment(property) ? property.initializer : property.name;
        assert.ok(!constant(expression), `Constant producer check: ${name(property.name)}`);
        checks.push({key:name(property.name), start:expression.getStart(file), end:expression.end,
          shorthand:ts.isShorthandPropertyAssignment(property)});
      }
    }
    ts.forEachChild(node, visit);
  };
  visit(file);
  assert.ok(checks.length > 0, "Missing producer check expressions");
  return checks;
}

test("producer checks reject literal and constant-alias replacements", async () => {
  const source = await readFile(new URL("./plugin-persistence-main.ts", import.meta.url), "utf8");
  const checks = assertNoConstantProducerChecks(source);
  for (const check of checks) {
    for (const replacement of ["true", "false", "0", '"committed"', "[50, 50, 50]"]) {
      const value = check.shorthand ? `${check.key}: ${replacement}` : replacement;
      const changed = source.slice(0, check.start) + value + source.slice(check.end);
      assert.throws(() => assertNoConstantProducerChecks(changed), /Constant producer check/,
        `constant substitution for ${check.key}`);
    }
  }
  assert.throws(() => assertNoConstantProducerChecks(
    "const expected = true; function producer() { return {checks:{observed:expected}}; }"),
    /Constant producer check/);
});
```

Create `docs/en/plugin-settings-storage.md` with this content:

```md
# Plugin settings and records

Executable foundation samples are the [JavaScript consumer](../../tests/desktop/fixtures/plugin-persistence/consumer.ts) and [Python consumer](../../tests/desktop/fixtures/plugin-persistence/consumer.py). T7 runs both through their public SDK transports: read settings, perform a revision-checked CAS, observe watch invalidation and re-read; write/seal/commit a record, export with a fresh user action, and register a cooperative drain callback. Follow the settings CAS/watch and storage/export/drain contracts in [this settings guide](plugin-settings-storage.md). The interop report must record both consumers executing; Python SKIP fails the gate. Product-specific mapping samples remain pending in 3D/3E.

Plugin API 1.7.0 adds typed settings, bounded records, explicit export/copy, and cooperative drain. A settings resource declares version 1 and a packaged JSON path. Settings schemaVersion and record schemaVersion are application data versions; they are separate from Plugin API and UI resource versions.

Declare only the permissions you need: settings.read, settings.write, storage.read, storage.write, storage.export, and ui.clipboard. The host binds requests to your source and execution. IDs and handles do not authorize another source. Settings and records are not an encrypted secret store, and process isolation is not an OS sandbox.

Settings apply one field at a time. Boolean/enum changes submit immediately; text/number changes submit on blur or Enter. There is no Apply button. A successful CAS receipt publishes the value. An invalid or failed edit retains the field's draft and error. Read the current snapshot and explicitly retry after a revision conflict; do not silently overwrite another window's edit. Reset follows the same CAS path.

Settings have at most 128 keys and 64 KiB of serialized values; a string is at most 4 KiB. Settings keys may contain dots. Enum values preserve their types: numeric 1 differs from string "1". Watch delivers invalidations without values; re-read when needed. settings.unwatch calls events/unsubscribe, whose first successful removal is true and whose repeated tombstone removal is false. There is no settings/unwatch wire method.

Records are at most 8 MiB, 256 records and 512 MiB per source, with a 1 GiB host limit. Use beginWrite, ordered writeChunk calls, sealWrite, then commitWrite. Chunks contain canonical base64 and decode to at most 256 KiB. Two staging writes per source and sixteen per host reserve their full payload. Replacing a record requires its expected revision and reserves the replacement before releasing the old object. Read handles pin one revision; lists are bounded snapshots with pages of at most 64 entries. Close read handles when finished.

A commit receipt identifies a committed head. An unknown result means publication needs reconciliation; it does not mean rollback. Do not automatically repeat create, commit, delete, export, or copy. flush does not commit incomplete payloads. Staging/read/list leases expire after 30 seconds idle and 120 seconds total; retry does not renew the original total deadline.

Export and copy require a fresh single-use actionRef from a real host user action. An invocationId is not an actionRef. Activation, timers and watch callbacks do not create one. Export starts a bounded asynchronous dialog job; user cancellation is normal. The host owns the destination path, validates its identity and never returns it. Export permits one job per source and four per host, independently of staging slots. Copy writes plain text only, at most 64 KiB and 16,384 code points. The API cannot read the clipboard.

Register a checkpoint before recording. A drain callback has an independent cancellation scope and at most ten seconds. Its submitted response is not a saved receipt. Only committed final records plus a successful host flush can establish saved. A crash may preserve only the last checkpoint; retry is available only when the host holds complete payload bytes and the original retention period remains. Core recovery remains available when optional features are disabled or safe mode suppresses them.

The app permits one primary instance per profile. A second launch focuses the existing window and exits before initializing another writer. Closing the app coordinates storage drain with device stop and the fault journal. A cancelled close does not revive old handles, motion or recording. Disconnect completes stop/save before disconnecting. Suspend requests final save, but the OS may freeze I/O before it completes; wake does not resume recording automatically.

Legacy import is a host-allowlisted one-time operation. Originals are preserved. Plans, item receipts and the completion marker are durable, and restarts reuse planned destination IDs. Missing renderer evidence remains pending. Completed import does not recreate a record the user later deletes. This foundation includes synthetic import tests only; actual Sensor Lab mappings belong to stage 3D and device preference mappings to stage 3E.

JavaScript methods use camelCase names. Python methods use snake_case names but retain camelCase wire keys in their parameter dictionaries. Both return the same ok/value/error business envelopes. Transport and numeric protocol failures raise RpcError. API 1.4, 1.5 and 1.6 consumers remain compatible and do not receive persistence drain or settings events. UI resource v2 and Plugin API 1.8 belong to stage 3D.
```

```md
# 插件設定與資料紀錄

可執行的基礎範例為 [JavaScript consumer](../../tests/desktop/fixtures/plugin-persistence/consumer.ts) 與 [Python consumer](../../tests/desktop/fixtures/plugin-persistence/consumer.py)。T7 透過兩種公開 SDK transport 執行：讀取設定、依 revision 執行 CAS、收到 watch invalidation 後重新讀取；寫入／seal／commit record、以新的使用者 action 匯出，並註冊協作式 drain callback。設定 CAS／watch 與 storage／export／drain 契約詳見[本設定指南](plugin-settings-storage.md)。interop report 必須記錄兩個 consumer 的實際執行，Python SKIP 不算通過。產品專用 mapping 範例仍由 3D／3E 完成。

Plugin API 1.7.0 提供型別化設定、有上限的 records、明確使用者觸發的匯出／複製，以及協作式 drain。設定宣告使用 version 1 與封裝內的 JSON path。settings 與 record 的 schemaVersion 是資料版本，和 Plugin API、UI resource version 分開。

只宣告需要的 settings.read、settings.write、storage.read、storage.write、storage.export、ui.clipboard 權限。host 將請求綁定到來源與執行世代；ID 或 handle 不能授權另一個來源。這些資料不是加密的秘密儲存區，程序隔離也不是 OS sandbox。

設定逐欄立即套用：boolean／enum 選擇後提交，文字與數字在 blur／Enter 時提交，沒有 Apply 按鈕。CAS 成功並收到 receipt 後才發布值。驗證或保存失敗會保留該欄 draft 與錯誤；revision 衝突時先讀取新 snapshot，再由使用者明確重試，不能覆蓋另一視窗的修改。單欄 Reset 走同一 CAS 路徑。

設定最多 128 keys、序列化 values 共 64 KiB，單一字串最多 4 KiB。key 可含點號；數字 1 與字串 "1" 是不同 enum 值。watch 只傳 invalidation，不傳值；需要時重新 read。settings.unwatch 包裝 events/unsubscribe，首次移除回 true，重複 tombstone 回 false，沒有 settings/unwatch wire method。

單筆 record 最多 8 MiB，每來源最多 256 筆／512 MiB，host 總上限 1 GiB。依序 beginWrite、writeChunk、sealWrite、commitWrite；chunk 是 canonical base64，解碼後最多 256 KiB。每來源最多兩個 staging、host 最多十六個，受理時預留完整 payload。replacement 需要 expected revision，先預留新資料才釋放舊 object。read handle 固定一個 revision，list 是有期限的 snapshot，每頁最多 64 筆；讀完要 close。

receipt 證明已提交的 head。unknown 表示必須對帳，不能解讀成 rollback；不要自動重送 create、commit、delete、export 或 copy。flush 不會替 caller 提交不完整 payload。staging／read／list 最多閒置 30 秒、總計 120 秒；重試不延長原本總期限。

匯出與複製需要 host 真實使用者動作產生、有效五秒且只可用一次的 actionRef。invocationId 不能替代它，activation、timer、watch callback 都不能取得它。匯出先建立非同步 dialog job，使用者取消不是保存錯誤。host 管理目的地並檢查身分，不回傳實體路徑。每來源一個／host 四個 export jobs，與 staging slots 分開。copy 只寫純文字，最多 64 KiB／16,384 code points，不能讀剪貼簿。

錄製前應 registerCheckpoint。drain callback 使用獨立取消範圍，最多十秒；submitted 不表示 saved。只有 final records 已收到 commit receipt 且 host flush 成功，才可宣稱保存完成。當機可能只留下最後 checkpoint；只有 host 已持有完整 payload 且原保留期限未到，才有 retry。停用 optional features 或進入 safe mode 後，核心 recovery 仍可使用。

同一 profile 只允許一個 primary instance。第二次啟動聚焦現有視窗後退出，不初始化另一個 writer。關閉 app 會協調 storage drain、device stop 與 fault journal；取消關閉不會復活舊 handles、motion 或錄製。Disconnect 先確認 stop／save 才斷線。suspend 會要求 final save，但 OS 可能先凍結 I/O；wake 不自動續錄。

Legacy import 是 host allowlist 管理的一次性作業。原始檔保留不變；plan、逐項 receipt 與 complete marker 持久化，重啟沿用原先配置的目標 IDs。缺 renderer evidence 時維持 pending。完成後使用者刪掉新 record，不會再次匯入。此基礎階段只含 synthetic mapper；真正 Sensor Lab 對應在 3D、device preferences 對應在 3E 驗收。

JavaScript method 使用 camelCase；Python method 使用 snake_case，但 params dict 的 wire keys 保留 camelCase。兩者保留相同 ok／value／error business envelope，transport／numeric protocol failure 才拋 RpcError。1.4、1.5、1.6 consumers 維持相容，不收到 persistence drain 或 settings events。UI v2 與 Plugin API 1.8 由 3D 發布。
```

- [ ] **Step 4: Assemble the actual JS clients and invocation-local actions**

In SDK `index.ts`, import `createSettingsClient` and `PersistenceRequest` from `settings.ts`, `createStorageClient` from `storage.ts`, and `createPersistenceActionsClient` from `persistence-actions.ts`. Re-export their public types without editing the T1-owned modules. `PersistenceRequest` has `(method,params,options:{timeoutMs:number;signal?:AbortSignal})=>Promise<result>` over the frozen maps. Client calls accept `(params, signal?)`, not an options wrapper. Export methods live on the actions client.

Use this assembly helper in `index.ts`; it forwards only transport and reuses all T1 validators:

```ts
export function createPersistenceContext(peer: RpcPeer, signal?: AbortSignal) {
  const request: PersistenceRequest = (method, params, options) =>
    peer.request(method, params, {...options, signal:options.signal ?? signal});
  const client = createSettingsClient(request);
  const settings = Object.assign(client, {
    unwatch: (params: ParamsOf<"events/unsubscribe">, signal?: AbortSignal) =>
      peer.request("events/unsubscribe", params, {timeoutMs:10000, signal}),
  });
  const storage = createStorageClient(request);
  const actions: ReturnType<typeof createPersistenceActionsClient> & {readonly actionRef?:Handle} =
    createPersistenceActionsClient(request);
  return {settings, storage, actions, ui:{copyText:actions.copyText}};
}
export interface PersistenceDrainContext {
  readonly request: DrainRequest;
  readonly signal: AbortSignal;
  readonly storage: ReturnType<typeof createStorageClient>;
}
function supportsPersistence(version: string): boolean {
  const match = /^1\.([0-9]+)\.[0-9]+$/.exec(version);
  return match !== null && Number(match[1]) >= 7;
}
```

Extend `PluginContext.settings` with `ReturnType<typeof createPersistenceContext>["settings"]` (the factory client plus unwatch sugar), and `.storage` with its factory return type; `.actions` is `ReturnType<typeof createPersistenceActionsClient> & {readonly actionRef?:Handle}`. Merge `copyText` into the existing UI member and preserve all devices/UI/commands functionality. Add `drain?(context:PersistenceDrainContext):ResultOf<"storage/drain">|Promise<ResultOf<"storage/drain">>` to `PluginDefinition`. Normal context construction calls this helper once per bound peer.

Extend the existing P160 factory, preserving its P160 fields and signal semantics, with this body (the factory signature is frozen):

```ts
export function createInvocationContext(
  base: PluginContext, invocation: CommandInvocation, signal: AbortSignal,
): PluginContext & {readonly invocation:CommandInvocation;readonly signal:AbortSignal} {
  const actionRef = invocation.context.actionRef;
  const actions = Object.create(base.actions);
  if (actionRef !== undefined) Object.defineProperty(actions, "actionRef", {
    enumerable:true, configurable:false, get:() => actionRef,
  });
  Object.freeze(actions);
  return {...base, invocation, signal, actions};
}
```

Each invocation gets a fresh actions object and read-only accessor; the base has no actionRef. Overlapping invocations and absent refs stay isolated. Command execution must use this named factory, never a global current invocation or shared base mutation. Preserve any existing P160 invocation-bound method closures while adding these members.

Add `settings.unwatch` sugar in the common context adapter, sending `events/unsubscribe` and returning its original `{removed:boolean}` business result, without adding it to the low-level SettingsRequestMap or registering a private RPC. Watch gaps trigger the actual settings read/snapshot reconciliation through that same queue. No new event consumer is installed.

```ts
peer.handle("storage/drain", async (request, {signal}) => {
  if (!persistenceNegotiated || !definition.drain)
```

```python
class PersistenceContextTest(unittest.IsolatedAsyncioTestCase):
    def setUp(self):

        self.redirect = redirect_stdout(io.TextIOWrapper(self.output, encoding="utf-8"))
        self.redirect.__enter__()
        self.addCleanup(self.redirect.__exit__, None, None, None)

    async def test_clients_preserve_wire_keys_business_errors_and_unwatch(self):
        from kobrixa._plugin import CommandContext
        plugin = Plugin()
        calls = []
        result = {"ok": False, "error": {"code": "PLUGIN_E_SETTINGS_CONFLICT",
            "message": "Revision changed", "detail": {"kind": "persistence", "reason": "revision-mismatch"}}}
        async def request(method, params, **options):
            calls.append((method, params))
            if method == "events/unsubscribe":
                return {"ok":True,"value":{"removed":True}}
            return result
        plugin._request = request
        ctx = CommandContext(plugin)
        params = {"schemaVersion": 1, "expectedRevision": None,
                  "changes": [{"key": "fixture.enabled", "value": True}]}
        self.assertEqual(await ctx.settings.update(params), result)
        self.assertEqual(calls[-1], ("settings/update", params))
        await ctx.settings.unwatch({"subscriptionId": "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"})
        self.assertEqual(calls[-1][0], "events/unsubscribe")
        self.assertFalse(hasattr(ctx.actions, "actionRef"))

    async def test_actions_copy_only_action_ref_and_never_invocation_id(self):
        from kobrixa._plugin import CommandContext, create_invocation_context
        plugin = Plugin()
        base = CommandContext(plugin)
        invocation = {"invocationId":"11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", "context":{}}
        self.assertFalse(hasattr(create_invocation_context(base, invocation).actions, "actionRef"))
        invocation["context"]["actionRef"] = "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222"
        first = create_invocation_context(base, invocation)
        invocation["context"]["actionRef"] = "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333"
        second = create_invocation_context(base, invocation)
        self.assertEqual(first.actions.actionRef, "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222")
        self.assertEqual(second.actions.actionRef, "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333")
        with self.assertRaises(AttributeError):
            first.actions.actionRef = "forged"
        self.assertFalse(hasattr(base.actions, "actionRef"))

        from kobrixa import RpcError
        request = {"token": "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", "reason": "shutdown",
                   "remainingMs": 10000, "checkpoints": [], "writes": []}
        for version in ("1.4.0", "1.5.0", "1.6.0", "1.7.0"):

            calls.append(ctx.request["token"])
```

```python
from copy import copy
from kobrixa._settings import create_settings_client
from kobrixa._storage import create_storage_client
from kobrixa._persistence_actions import create_persistence_actions_client

class _InvocationActions:
    def __init__(self, client, invocation):
        self._client = client
        self._action_ref = invocation.get("context", {}).get("actionRef")

    @property
    def actionRef(self):
        if self._action_ref is None:
            raise AttributeError("actionRef")
        return self._action_ref

    def __getattr__(self, name):
        return getattr(self._client, name)


def create_invocation_context(base, invocation):
    context = copy(base)
    context.invocation = invocation
    context.actions = _InvocationActions(base.actions, invocation)
    return context


class PersistenceDrainContext:
    def __init__(self, request, storage):
        self.request = request
        self.storage = storage


def _supports_persistence(version):
    parts = version.split(".")
    return len(parts) == 3 and all(part.isascii() and part.isdigit() for part in parts) and \
        int(parts[0]) == 1 and int(parts[1]) >= 7
```

```python
            storage = create_storage_client(self._request)
            return await self._drain_handler(PersistenceDrainContext(params, storage))
```

```ts
const persistenceReasons = {
  PLUGIN_E_SETTINGS_SCHEMA: ["invalid-resource", "invalid-value", "duplicate-key", "unknown-key", "size-limit",
    "schema-changed-without-version", "migration-required", "downgrade", "unsupported-format", "corrupt"],
  PLUGIN_E_SETTINGS_CONFLICT: ["revision-mismatch"],
  PLUGIN_E_SETTINGS_SAVE: ["disk-full", "permission", "read-only", "io", "sync-failed", "publish-uncertain", "import-pending"],
  PLUGIN_E_STORAGE_QUOTA: ["record-count", "source-bytes", "host-bytes", "temporary-bytes"],
  PLUGIN_E_STORAGE_CONFLICT: ["revision-mismatch", "write-in-progress", "offset-mismatch", "sealed", "incomplete",
    "checksum-mismatch", "flush-incomplete", "export-not-ready"],
  PLUGIN_E_STORAGE_IO: ["not-found", "disk-full", "permission", "read-only", "io", "sync-failed", "publish-uncertain",
    "corrupt", "import-pending", "input-changed", "clipboard-unavailable", "destination-changed", "unsupported-filesystem"],
  PLUGIN_E_STORAGE_VERSION: ["unsupported-format", "schema-mismatch"],
} as const;
it("enforces closed code/kind/reason pairings rather than a Cartesian union", () => {
  const schemas = [settingsRequestSchemas, storageRequestSchemas, persistenceActionRequestSchemas];
  const resultSchemas = schemas.flatMap((map) => Object.values(map).map((entry) => entry.result));
  const accepts = (value: unknown) => resultSchemas.some((schema) => schema.safeParse(value).success);
  const reasons = [...new Set(Object.values(persistenceReasons).flat()), "deadline", "cancelled", "arbitrary"];
  for (const [code, allowed] of Object.entries(persistenceReasons)) {
    for (const reason of reasons) {
      const value = { ok: false, error: { code, message: "Synthetic failure",
        detail: { kind: "persistence", reason } } };
      expect(accepts(value), `${code}/${reason}`).toBe((allowed as readonly string[]).includes(reason));
    }
    expect(accepts({ ok: false, error: { code, message: "Synthetic failure",
      detail: { kind: "permission", reason: "io" } } })).toBe(false);
  }
  expect(accepts({ ok: false, error: { code: "PLUGIN_E_PERMISSION_DENIED", message: "Denied",
    detail: { kind: "persistence", reason: "permission" } } })).toBe(false);
  expect(accepts({ ok: false, error: { code: "PLUGIN_E_STALE_RESOURCE", message: "Stale",
    detail: { kind: "persistence", reason: "not-found" } } })).toBe(false);
});
```

```ts
import { z } from "zod";
const fixtureExpectedSchema = z.strictObject({
  numericCode:z.number().int().nullable(), businessCode:z.string().nullable(),
  reason:z.string().nullable(), permission:z.string().nullable(), lifetime:z.string().nullable(),
  persistedSha256:z.string().regex(/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/).nullable(),
});

  formatVersion:z.literal(1),
  family:z.enum(["device-broker-v1","declarative-ui-v1","settings-storage-v1"]),
  cases:z.array(z.strictObject({
    id:z.string().min(1), schema:z.string().refine(key => Object.hasOwn(SCHEMA_DEFINITIONS,key)),
    phase:z.enum(["params","result","resource","event"]), input:z.unknown(),
    valid:z.boolean(), expected:fixtureExpectedSchema,
  })).refine(cases => new Set(cases.map(entry => entry.id)).size === cases.length)
    .refine(cases => cases.every(entry => !entry.valid ||
      entry.expected.numericCode === null && entry.expected.businessCode === null && entry.expected.reason === null)),
});
```

```ts
interface PersistenceHost {
  readonly settings: BoundSettingsService;
  readonly recovery: PersistenceRecoveryHostPort;
  readonly participant: PersistenceParticipant;
  request<M extends keyof PersistenceRequestMap>(
    principal: Principal,
    method: M,
    params: PersistenceRequestMap[M]["params"],
    signal: AbortSignal,
  ): Promise<PersistenceRequestMap[M]["result"]>;
  dispose(): Promise<void>;
}
interface PersistenceParticipant {
  // 同步對帳 ended／pending bindings，只封住該 recording target，不 freeze owner。
  endReservation(event: ReservationEnded, deadline: number): DrainOffer | null;
  // 同步關閉普通 admission，擷取已受理工作；可與 broker revocation 同一回合呼叫。
  freeze(
    owner: PersistenceOwner,
    reason: DrainReason,
    deadline: number,
    deviceDrain?: DeviceDrainGrant,
  ): DrainOffer;
  // 以獨立 drain request 喚醒仍健康的原 process；不延長 deadline。
  drain(offer: DrainOffer, dispatch: DrainDispatcher): Promise<DrainReport>;
  // owner 已死亡，不 dispatch；只處理 host 已持有的 ticket，保留 checkpoint。
  ownerLost(owner: PersistenceOwner): Promise<DrainReport>;
  // 接 core recovery snapshot；retry／discard 僅接受可信 UI action，不是 plugin RPC。
  recoverySnapshot(): PersistenceRecoverySnapshot;
  retry(recovery: Handle, action: CoreActionReference): Promise<DrainReport>;
  discard(recovery: Handle, action: CoreActionReference): Promise<DrainReport>;
}
interface SettingsFormPort {
  open(
    binding: SettingsFormBinding,
    resource: SettingsResourceV1,
    snapshot: SettingsSnapshot,
  ): void;
  replaceSnapshot(binding: SettingsFormBinding, snapshot: SettingsSnapshot): void;
  showFailure(
    binding: SettingsFormBinding,
    error: { code: PluginErrorCode; message: string; detail?: PersistenceFailureDetail },
  ): void;
  dispose(binding: SettingsFormBinding): void;
}
interface LegacyImportCoordinator {
  run(
    descriptor: LegacyImportDescriptor,
    signal: AbortSignal,
  ): Promise<{
    state: "pending" | "planned" | "copying" | "complete" | "complete-empty" | "blocked";
    completedItems: number;
    totalItems: number;
  }>;
  acceptPreferences(snapshot: LegacyPreferencesSnapshot): Promise<void>;
}
```

```ts
import type { Stage3RuntimePorts, Stage3HostAttachment, UiRuntimeAttachment } from "@kobrixa/plugin-runtime";
```

- [ ] **Step 2a: Implement R170 retained-peer dispatch before admitting persistence.**

In `supervisor.ts`, add the following local exported implementation (direct-module test import only). The manager retains the same object used by the supervisor; it is not a second process registry. `remainingMs` is converted once per token, then clamped on every repeat. This preserves the original deadline even if a caller reuses a token with a larger budget during the 120-second outcome window. The trusted T5 offer registry rejects expired tokens before dispatch, including after runtime tombstone expiry; the runtime map follows that same 64/source retention bound. An unregistered SDK supplies the existing numeric methodNotFound; no callback bit is added to initialize.

```ts
import type { DrainDispatcher, PersistenceOwner } from "./persistence-participant.js";
import type { DrainRequest } from "@kobrixa/plugin-protocol";

const persistencePeers170=new Map<RpcPeer,RetainedPersistenceChannel>();
export function persistenceChannelApiVersion(peer:RpcPeer):string|undefined{
  return persistencePeers170.get(peer)?.negotiatedVersion;
}
export class RetainedPersistenceChannel {
  private collected:()=>void=()=>{};
  private apiVersion: string | undefined;
  private exited = false;
  private lost = false;
  private settled = false;
  private loss: Promise<void> | undefined;
  private readonly deadlines = new Map<string, number>();
  constructor(
    readonly owner: PersistenceOwner,
    readonly peer: RpcPeer,
    private readonly now: () => number,
    private readonly ownerLost: () => Promise<void>,
  ) {
    if(persistencePeers170.has(peer))throw new Error("Peer already retained");
    persistencePeers170.set(peer,this);
  }
  get negotiatedVersion():string|undefined{return this.apiVersion;}
  onCollect(callback:()=>void):void{this.collected=callback;this.collect();}
  private collect():void{
    if(!this.releasable)return;
    persistencePeers170.delete(this.peer);this.deadlines.clear();this.collected();
  }
  negotiated(apiVersion: string): void { this.apiVersion = apiVersion; }
  disposition(): void { this.settled = true; this.collect(); }
  async confirmedExit(): Promise<void> { this.exited = true;await this.closed();this.collect(); }
  closed(): Promise<void> {
    this.lost = true;
    return this.loss ??= Promise.resolve().then(this.ownerLost);
  }
  get releasable(): boolean { return this.exited && this.settled; }
  dispatch: DrainDispatcher = async (owner, request, signal) => {
    if (persistenceChannelKey(owner) !== persistenceChannelKey(this.owner))
      throw new RpcError(RPC_ERRORS.permissionDenied, "Original owner required");
    const api = this.apiVersion?.split(".").map(Number);
    if (!api || api[0] !== 1 || api[1]! < 7)
      throw new RpcError(RPC_ERRORS.methodNotFound, "Persistence is not negotiated");
    if (this.lost || this.peer.closed) {
      await this.closed();
      throw new RpcError(RPC_ERRORS.connectionClosed, "Original peer is closed");
    }
    signal.throwIfAborted();
    for(const [token,deadline] of this.deadlines)if(this.now()>=deadline+120000)this.deadlines.delete(token);
    const proposed = this.now() + Math.min(10000, request.remainingMs);
    const deadline = Math.min(this.deadlines.get(request.token) ?? proposed, proposed);
    if (!this.deadlines.has(request.token) && this.deadlines.size >= 64)
      throw new RpcError(RPC_ERRORS.permissionDenied, "Drain token budget exhausted");
    this.deadlines.set(request.token, deadline);
    const remaining = deadline - this.now();
    if (remaining <= 0) throw new RpcError(RPC_ERRORS.timeout, "Original drain deadline elapsed");
    try {
      const reply = await this.peer.request("storage/drain", {
        ...request, remainingMs: Math.min(request.remainingMs, Math.floor(remaining)),
      }, { signal, timeoutMs: remaining });
      signal.throwIfAborted();
      if (this.lost || this.peer.closed || this.now() >= deadline)
        throw new RpcError(RPC_ERRORS.connectionClosed, "Original drain no longer live");
      return reply;
    } catch (error) {
      if (this.peer.closed) await this.closed();
      // In particular, methodNotFound is not a saved result. T5 reconciles
      // host-owned tickets/checkpoints through its existing dispatch-failure path.
      throw error;
    }
  };
}
export function persistenceChannelKey(owner: PersistenceOwner): string {
  return JSON.stringify([owner.sourceKey, owner.pluginId, owner.generation,
    owner.hostEpoch, owner.processEpoch]);
}
```

In `manager.ts`, use this implementation for the retained channel portion of the existing R150 cleanup registry:

```ts
import { RetainedPersistenceChannel, persistenceChannelKey } from "./supervisor.js";
import { RpcError, RPC_ERRORS } from "@kobrixa/plugin-protocol";
import type { DrainDispatcher, PersistenceOwner } from "./persistence-participant.js";

export class RetainedPersistenceChannels {
  private readonly rows = new Map<string, RetainedPersistenceChannel>();
  retain(row: RetainedPersistenceChannel): void {
    const key = persistenceChannelKey(row.owner);
    const old = this.rows.get(key);
    if (old && old !== row) throw new Error("Original channel cannot be replaced");
    this.rows.set(key, row);row.onCollect(()=>this.collect(row));
  }
  collect(row: RetainedPersistenceChannel): void {
    const key = persistenceChannelKey(row.owner);
    if (row.releasable && this.rows.get(key) === row) this.rows.delete(key);
  }
  dispatch: DrainDispatcher = (owner, request, signal) => {
    const row = this.rows.get(persistenceChannelKey(owner));
    if (!row) return Promise.reject(new RpcError(RPC_ERRORS.connectionClosed, "No retained original peer"));
    return row.dispatch(owner, request, signal);
  };
}
```

Here `owner`/`reason` are the existing retirement method's captured original arguments, not a sourceKey lookup. Preserve and return `disposition` in that method so the existing coordinator still owns the first retirement and process teardown. A rejected or still-pending disposition does not mark completion. Actual crash uses the existing cached coordinator `ownerLost` path and executes no `freeze` or plugin callback. A late callback only touches its captured original object.

```ts
export const persistenceRoutes170 = [
  "settings/read", "settings/update", "settings/reset", "settings/watch",
  "settings/readMigration", "settings/migrate", "storage/beginWrite", "storage/writeChunk",
  "storage/sealWrite", "storage/commitWrite", "storage/writeStatus", "storage/abortWrite",
  "storage/stat", "storage/list", "storage/openRead", "storage/readChunk", "storage/closeRead",
  "storage/delete", "storage/flush", "storage/quota", "storage/registerCheckpoint",
  "storage/abandonCheckpoint", "storage/exportBegin", "storage/exportChunk",
  "storage/exportCommit", "storage/exportStatus", "storage/exportCancel", "ui/copyText",
] as const satisfies readonly InboundPersistence170[];
type MissingRoute170 = Exclude<InboundPersistence170, typeof persistenceRoutes170[number]>;
const completeRoutes170: Record<MissingRoute170, never> = {};
void completeRoutes170;

export function bindPersistenceRoutes170(input: {
  context: Stage3ChannelContext; host: PersistenceHost; attachment: DeviceChannelAttachment;
  apiVersion(): string | undefined; admitted(): boolean;
}): () => void {
  let disposed = false;
  const principal = () => {
    const api = input.apiVersion()?.split(".").map(Number);
    if (!api || api[0] !== 1 || api[1]! < 7)
      throw new RpcError(RPC_ERRORS.methodNotFound, "Persistence is not negotiated");
    const p = input.context.principal();
    if (disposed || input.context.peer.closed || !input.admitted() || p.kind !== "plugin" ||
        !sameResourceOwner(p.owner, input.context.owner))
      throw new RpcError(RPC_ERRORS.permissionDenied, "Original admitted owner required");
    return p;
  };
  function bind<M extends Exclude<InboundPersistence170,"settings/watch">>(method: M): void {
    input.context.peer.handle(method, (params, request) =>
      input.host.request(principal(), method, params, request.signal));
  }
  for (const method of persistenceRoutes170) if (method !== "settings/watch") bind(method);
  input.context.peer.handle("settings/watch", async (params, request) => {
    const p = principal();
    const result = await input.host.request(p, "settings/watch", params, request.signal);
    if (result.ok) {
      const id = result.value.subscriptionId;
      request.afterReply(() => {
        try { principal(); input.attachment.negotiated("settings",1); input.attachment.activate(id); }
        catch { input.attachment.abandon(id); }
      }, () => input.attachment.abandon(id));
    }
    return result;
  });
  input.context.peer.handle("storage/drain", () => {
    throw new RpcError(RPC_ERRORS.methodNotFound, "storage/drain is host to plugin only");
  });
  return () => { disposed = true; };
}
```

```ts
import { describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
import type { LegacyPreferenceChallenge } from "../../shared/plugin-persistence.js";
import { collectLegacyPreferences, submitLegacyPreferences } from "./legacy-preferences-bridge.js";

const challenge: LegacyPreferenceChallenge = {
  nonce: "10000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002",
  scope: {
    hostEpoch: "10000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001",
    workbenchInstance: "10000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000003",
  },
  descriptorId: "synthetic.preferences",
  keys: ["fixture.layout", "fixture.number"],
};

describe("V170 legacy preference snapshot", () => {
  it("reads only the trusted allowlist, preserves raw strings/null, and never writes originals", () => {
    const storage = {
      getItem: vi.fn((key: string) => key === "fixture.layout" ? "001" : null),
      setItem: vi.fn(),
      removeItem: vi.fn(),
      clear: vi.fn(),
      key: vi.fn(),
    };
    expect(collectLegacyPreferences(challenge, storage)).toEqual({
      nonce: challenge.nonce,
      scope: challenge.scope,
      entries: [
        { key: "fixture.layout", raw: "001" },
        { key: "fixture.number", raw: null },
      ],
    });
    expect(storage.getItem.mock.calls).toEqual([["fixture.layout"], ["fixture.number"]]);
    for (const method of [storage.setItem, storage.removeItem, storage.clear, storage.key])
      expect(method).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it("keeps rejected challenge pending without reading storage", async () => {
    const storage = vi.fn(() => ({ getItem: vi.fn(() => null) }));
    const submit = vi.fn(async () => ({ state: "accepted" as const }));
    expect(await submitLegacyPreferences({ challenge: async () => { throw new Error("Descriptor not admitted"); }, submit }, storage, "synthetic.preferences")).toBe("pending");
    expect(storage).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(submit).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it("does not submit empty data after localStorage throws", async () => {
    const submit = vi.fn(async () => ({ state: "accepted" as const }));
    expect(await submitLegacyPreferences(
      { challenge: async () => challenge, submit },
      () => { throw new Error("Access denied"); }, "synthetic.preferences",
    )).toBe("pending");
    expect(submit).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it("requires the main durable acceptance result before reporting accepted", async () => {
    const submit = vi.fn(async () => ({ state: "pending" as "pending" | "accepted" | "reconciled" }));
    const api = { challenge: async () => challenge, submit };
    expect(await submitLegacyPreferences(api, () => ({ getItem: () => null }), "synthetic.preferences")).toBe("pending");
    submit.mockResolvedValueOnce({ state: "accepted" });
    expect(await submitLegacyPreferences(api, () => ({ getItem: () => null }), "synthetic.preferences")).toBe("accepted");
  });

  it.each([
    { ...challenge, keys: ["a", "a"] },
    { ...challenge, keys: Array.from({ length: 129 }, (_, index) => `fixture.${index}`) },
  ])("rejects invalid allowlists before reading", (invalid) => {
    const getItem = vi.fn(() => null);
    expect(() => collectLegacyPreferences(invalid, { getItem })).toThrow();
    expect(getItem).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it("bounds UTF-8 bytes and refuses oversized snapshots", () => {
    expect(() => collectLegacyPreferences(challenge, { getItem: () => "界".repeat(22_000) })).toThrow();
  });
});
```

Append to `shared/plugin-persistence.ts`; merge type-only imports/re-exports from T0, do not duplicate `LegacyPreferencesSnapshot`:

```ts
import type { CoreWindowScope } from "@kobrixa/plugin-runtime";
import type { LegacyPreferencesSnapshot, LegacyPreferenceChallenge, LegacyImportHostPort } from "../main/plugins/persistence/import-sources.js";
export type { LegacyPreferencesSnapshot } from "../main/plugins/persistence/import-sources.js";

export type { LegacyPreferenceChallenge } from "../main/plugins/persistence/import-sources.js";
export interface LegacyPreferencesApi {
  challenge(descriptorId: string): Promise<LegacyPreferenceChallenge>;
  submit(snapshot: LegacyPreferencesSnapshot): ReturnType<LegacyImportHostPort["acceptPreferencesEvidence"]>;
}

const importHandle170 = /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-4[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/;
const encoder170 = new TextEncoder();

function exactObject170(value: unknown, names: readonly string[]): value is Record<string, unknown> {
  return value !== null && typeof value === "object" && !Array.isArray(value) &&
    Object.keys(value).length === names.length &&
    names.every((name) => Object.hasOwn(value, name));
}

export function isLegacyPreferencesSnapshot(value: unknown): value is LegacyPreferencesSnapshot {
  if (!exactObject170(value, ["nonce", "scope", "entries"])) return false;
  if (typeof value.nonce !== "string" || !importHandle170.test(value.nonce)) return false;
  if (!exactObject170(value.scope, ["hostEpoch", "workbenchInstance"])) return false;
  if (![value.scope.hostEpoch, value.scope.workbenchInstance].every(
    (item) => typeof item === "string" && importHandle170.test(item),
  )) return false;
  if (!Array.isArray(value.entries) || value.entries.length > 128) return false;
  const keys = new Set<string>();
  let codeUnits = 0;
  for (const entry of value.entries) {
    if (!exactObject170(entry, ["key", "raw"])) return false;
    if (typeof entry.key !== "string" || entry.key.length === 0 || entry.key.includes("\0")) return false;
    if (entry.raw !== null && typeof entry.raw !== "string") return false;
    if (keys.has(entry.key)) return false;
    codeUnits += entry.key.length + (typeof entry.raw === "string" ? entry.raw.length : 0);
    if (codeUnits > 64 * 1024) return false;
    keys.add(entry.key);
  }
  return encoder170.encode(JSON.stringify(value)).byteLength <= 64 * 1024;
}
```

Create the complete `renderer/settings/legacy-preferences-bridge.ts`:

```ts
import {
  isLegacyPreferencesSnapshot,
  type LegacyPreferenceChallenge,
  type LegacyPreferencesApi,
  type LegacyPreferencesSnapshot,
} from "../../shared/plugin-persistence.js";

export function collectLegacyPreferences(
  challenge: LegacyPreferenceChallenge,
  storage: Pick<Storage, "getItem">,
): LegacyPreferencesSnapshot {
  const empty: LegacyPreferencesSnapshot = {
    nonce: challenge.nonce,
    scope: { ...challenge.scope },
    entries: challenge.keys.map((key) => ({ key, raw: null })),
  };
  if (!isLegacyPreferencesSnapshot(empty)) throw new Error("Invalid import challenge");
  const snapshot: LegacyPreferencesSnapshot = {
    ...empty,
    entries: challenge.keys.map((key) => ({ key, raw: storage.getItem(key) })),
  };
  if (!isLegacyPreferencesSnapshot(snapshot)) throw new Error("Import snapshot exceeds its limit");
  return snapshot;
}

export async function submitLegacyPreferences(
  api: LegacyPreferencesApi,
  storage: () => Pick<Storage, "getItem">,
  descriptorId: string,
): Promise<"accepted" | "pending" | "reconciled"> {
  try {
    const challenge = await api.challenge(descriptorId);
    const snapshot = collectLegacyPreferences(challenge, storage());
    return (await api.submit(snapshot)).state;
  } catch {
    return "pending";
  }
}
```

```ts
import type { CoreWindowScope } from "@kobrixa/plugin-runtime";
import type { LegacyImportHostPort } from "./persistence/import-sources.js";
import { isLegacyPreferencesSnapshot, type LegacyPreferencesApi } from "../../shared/plugin-persistence.js";

export function legacyPreferencesFor170(
  scope: CoreWindowScope,
  imports: Pick<LegacyImportHostPort, "issuePreferences" | "acceptPreferencesEvidence">,
): LegacyPreferencesApi {
  return {
    challenge: (descriptorId) => imports.issuePreferences({ descriptorId, scope }),
    submit: async (snapshot) => {
      if (!isLegacyPreferencesSnapshot(snapshot) ||
          snapshot.scope.hostEpoch !== scope.hostEpoch ||
          snapshot.scope.workbenchInstance !== scope.workbenchInstance)
        throw new Error("Invalid preference scope");
      return imports.acceptPreferencesEvidence({ ...snapshot, scope });
    },
  };
}
```

In `main/ipc.ts` register through the existing trusted sender/top-frame wrapper; `scopeFor` below is the main lifetime registry lookup supplied by D160, evaluated independently for each event:

```ts
export function registerLegacyPreferencesIpc170(
  handle: IpcHandle,
  imports: LegacyImportHostPort,
  scopeFor: (event: IpcMainInvokeEvent) => CoreWindowScope,
): () => void {
  let disposed = false;
  const bridge = (event: IpcMainInvokeEvent) => {
    if (disposed) throw new Error("Stale preferences window");
    return legacyPreferencesFor170(scopeFor(event), imports);
  };
  handle("persistence:legacy-preferences-challenge", (event, descriptorId: string) =>
    bridge(event).challenge(descriptorId));
  handle("persistence:legacy-preferences-submit", (event, snapshot: LegacyPreferencesSnapshot) =>
    bridge(event).submit(snapshot));
  return () => { disposed = true; };
}
```

T6 owns the one in-flight challenge per scope/descriptor and durable nonce state; the bridge issues no UUID, no key allowlist and no consumption flag. On window retirement call `imports.retirePreferences(scope)`. T6 persists raw evidence/digest before atomic consumption, restores it on restart, reconciles uncertain writes without republishing and rejects changed replay. `acceptPreferences` remains the Promise<void> compatibility facet; trusted UI uses `acceptPreferencesEvidence`.

Add this complete implementation to `main/plugins/ipc.ts`, combining imports. Ownership compares all six binding fields, not object identity or only the source key. Each open replaces the previous form even when its asynchronous result has not arrived. The bridge accepts no renderer scope.

```ts
import type { BoundSettingsService, CoreWindowScope, SettingsFormBinding } from "@kobrixa/plugin-runtime";
import type { PluginsApi } from "../../shared/plugins.js";
import { settingsRequestSchemas } from "@kobrixa/plugin-protocol";

export const settingsBinding170 = z.strictObject({
  owner: z.strictObject({sourceKey:sourceKeySchema,pluginId:namespacedIdSchema,
    uiResourceGeneration:z.number().int().nonnegative().max(Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER)}),
  scope:z.strictObject({hostEpoch:z.uuid(),workbenchInstance:z.uuid()}),
  resourceDigest:z.string().regex(/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/),
});
const sameScope170 = (a:CoreWindowScope,b:CoreWindowScope) =>
  a.hostEpoch===b.hostEpoch && a.workbenchInstance===b.workbenchInstance;
const sameSettings170 = (a:SettingsFormBinding,b:SettingsFormBinding) =>
  sameScope170(a.scope,b.scope) && a.owner.sourceKey===b.owner.sourceKey &&
  a.owner.pluginId===b.owner.pluginId && a.owner.uiResourceGeneration===b.owner.uiResourceGeneration &&
  a.resourceDigest===b.resourceDigest;
export function bindSettingsBridge(service:BoundSettingsService,scope:()=>CoreWindowScope):PluginsApi["settings"] {
  let generation=0;
  let openingTail:Promise<void>=Promise.resolve();
  let issued:SettingsFormBinding|undefined;
  const watches=new Set<()=>void>();
  const clear=()=>{
    ++generation;
    for(const off of watches) off(); watches.clear();
    const old=issued; issued=undefined;
    if(old) service.dispose(old);
  };
  const check=(binding:SettingsFormBinding)=>{
    const current=scope();
    if(issued && !sameScope170(issued.scope,current)) clear();
    if(!issued || !sameSettings170(issued,binding) || !sameScope170(binding.scope,current))
      throw new Error("Stale settings binding");
    return issued;
  };
  return {
    async open(input){
      clear(); const opening=generation; const admitted=structuredClone(scope());
      const previous=openingTail;
      let release!:()=>void;openingTail=new Promise<void>(resolve=>{release=resolve;});
      await previous;
      if(opening!==generation || !sameScope170(admitted,scope())){release();throw new Error("Stale settings open");}
      let opened:Awaited<ReturnType<BoundSettingsService["open"]>>;
      try{opened=await service.open({...input,scope:admitted});}catch(error){release();throw error;}
      release();
      if(opening!==generation || !sameScope170(admitted,scope()) ||
          !sameScope170(opened.binding.scope,admitted) || opened.binding.owner.sourceKey!==input.sourceKey ||
          opened.binding.resourceDigest!==input.resourceDigest){
        service.dispose(opened.binding); throw new Error("Stale settings open");
      }
      issued=structuredClone(opened.binding); return opened;
    },
    async read(binding){const original=check(binding),epoch=generation; const result=await service.read(original); check(original); if(epoch!==generation)throw new Error("Stale settings read");return result;},
    async update(binding,params){const original=check(binding),epoch=generation; const result=await service.update(original,params);check(original);if(epoch!==generation)throw new Error("Stale settings update");return result;},
    async reset(binding,params){const original=check(binding),epoch=generation; const result=await service.reset(original,params);check(original);if(epoch!==generation)throw new Error("Stale settings reset");return result;},
    watch(binding,changed){
      const original=check(binding); let active=true; let offService=()=>{};
      const off=()=>{if(!active)return;active=false;offService();watches.delete(off);};
      watches.add(off);
      offService=service.watch(original,()=>{
        if(!active)return;
        try{check(original);}catch{off();return;}
        changed();
      });
      if(!active)offService();
      return off;
    },
    dispose(binding){check(binding);clear();},
  };
}

export function registerSettingsIpc170(input:{
  handle:IpcHandle; service:BoundSettingsService; scope:()=>CoreWindowScope;
  publish:(scope:CoreWindowScope,channel:string,payload:unknown)=>void;
}):()=>void {
  const bridge=bindSettingsBridge(input.service,input.scope);
  let binding:SettingsFormBinding|undefined;
  let off:()=>void=()=>{};
  let closed=false;let watching=0;let openGeneration=0;
  const openSchema=z.strictObject({sourceKey:sourceKeySchema,resourceDigest:z.string().regex(/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/)});
  const watchSchema=z.strictObject({binding:settingsBinding170,watch:z.number().int().positive().max(Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER)});
  const active=()=>{if(closed)throw new Error("Settings window retired");};
  input.handle("plugins:settings:open",async(_event,value:unknown)=>{
    active();const generation=++openGeneration;off();off=()=>{};binding=undefined;
    const opened=await bridge.open(openSchema.parse(value));
    if(closed){bridge.dispose(opened.binding);throw new Error("Settings window retired");}
    if(generation!==openGeneration)throw new Error("Stale settings open");
    binding=opened.binding;return opened;
  });
  input.handle("plugins:settings:read",(_event,value:unknown)=>{active();return bridge.read(settingsBinding170.parse(value));});
  input.handle("plugins:settings:update",(_event,value:unknown,params:unknown)=>{active();
    return bridge.update(settingsBinding170.parse(value),settingsRequestSchemas["settings/update"].params.parse(params));});
  input.handle("plugins:settings:reset",(_event,value:unknown,params:unknown)=>{active();
    return bridge.reset(settingsBinding170.parse(value),settingsRequestSchemas["settings/reset"].params.parse(params));});
  input.handle("plugins:settings:watch",(_event,value:unknown)=>{
    active();const request=watchSchema.parse(value);off();watching=request.watch;
    off=bridge.watch(request.binding,()=>input.publish(request.binding.scope,"plugins:settings:changed",request));
  });
  input.handle("plugins:settings:unwatch",(_event,value:unknown)=>{
    active();const request=watchSchema.parse(value);
    // Validate ownership even for removal; a foreign window cannot remove a watch.
    if(!binding || !sameSettings170(binding,request.binding) || !sameScope170(binding.scope,input.scope()))
      throw new Error("Stale settings binding");
    if(request.watch===watching){off();off=()=>{};watching=0;}
  });
  input.handle("plugins:settings:dispose",(_event,value:unknown)=>{
    active();const candidate=settingsBinding170.parse(value);bridge.dispose(candidate);++openGeneration;
    off();off=()=>{};binding=undefined;
  });
  return ()=>{if(closed)return;closed=true;++openGeneration;off();off=()=>{};
    if(binding){try{bridge.dispose(binding);}catch{/* Already retired by the scope guard. */}binding=undefined;}};
}
```

`registerPersistenceWindow170` in Step 13a is the sole registrar for these handlers, through the existing trusted main-frame wrapper.

Both `preload/index.ts` and `tests/desktop/preload.cjs` use this identical body (remove only TypeScript annotations in CJS). It exposes synchronous disposer functions while subscription establishment is asynchronous; a read after watch acknowledgement closes the open→subscribe invalidation gap. Transport failure triggers a read, whose error remains visible in the mount.

```ts
function createSettingsPreload170(): PluginsApi["settings"] {
  let nextWatch=0;
  return {
    open:input=>ipcRenderer.invoke("plugins:settings:open",input),
    read:binding=>ipcRenderer.invoke("plugins:settings:read",binding),
    update:(binding,params)=>ipcRenderer.invoke("plugins:settings:update",binding,params),
    reset:(binding,params)=>ipcRenderer.invoke("plugins:settings:reset",binding,params),
    watch(binding,changed){
      const watch=++nextWatch; let active=true;
      const receive=(_event:Electron.IpcRendererEvent,value:{watch:number})=>{if(active && value.watch===watch)changed();};
      ipcRenderer.on("plugins:settings:changed",receive);
      void ipcRenderer.invoke("plugins:settings:watch",{binding,watch}).then(()=>{
        if(active)changed();
      },()=>{if(active)changed();});
      return ()=>{if(!active)return;active=false;ipcRenderer.removeListener("plugins:settings:changed",receive);
        void ipcRenderer.invoke("plugins:settings:unwatch",{binding,watch}).catch(()=>{});};
    },
    dispose(binding){void ipcRenderer.invoke("plugins:settings:dispose",binding).catch(()=>{});},
  };
}
// Add inside the existing plugins object in each preload:
// settings: createSettingsPreload170(),
```

```ts
import { registerSettingsIpc170 } from "./ipc.js";
import type { IpcHandle } from "../ipc.js";
import type { IpcMainInvokeEvent } from "electron";
function ipcHandlers170(){
  const handlers=new Map<string,(event:IpcMainInvokeEvent,...args:unknown[])=>unknown>();
  const handle:IpcHandle=<T extends unknown[],R>(name:string,action:(event:IpcMainInvokeEvent,...args:T)=>R)=>{
    handlers.set(name,(event,...args)=>action(event,...args as T));
  };

    const action=handlers.get(name);if(!action)throw new Error("Missing dedicated handler");

  return {handle,invoke,handlers};
}
```
